title: Efforts to Increase Availability and Uptake of Screening for Common Types of Cancer
what_it_is: Efforts to Increase Availability and Uptake of Screening for Common Types of Cancer

sections.label: Cancer screening and healthier lifestyles
sections.summary: Healthier SG subsidises screening for breast, cervical and colorectal cancer, while lung and liver screening is only for high-risk individuals, alongside healthier lifestyle promotion.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Under Healthier SG, regular screening for common cancers, such as breast, cervical and colorectal cancer, is recommended and heavily subsidised, and we hope it will shape positive changes to health-seeking habits over time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As for screening for lung and liver cancer, it is only recommended for high-risk individuals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As such cancers are less common in the general population and there are limitations in the accuracy of screening tests, general population screening has lower yield compared to more targeted screening and can lead to many false positive results, requiring further investigations and causing unnecessary anxiety.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, to address the burden of disease of cancer, the Ministry of Health (MOH) has been promoting healthier lifestyles, for example, not smoking, limiting alcohol consumption, healthy diets and physical activity, all of which are modifiable risk factors for cancer.

sections.label: Screening recommendations and resourcing
sections.summary: Screening decisions reference the Screening Test Review Committee, and general population schemes require separate resourcing and assessment of prevalence and test effectiveness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: When we do this, we actually make reference to the recommendations by the Screening Test Review Committee and we take deference from that.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Because this does mean that we do have to allocate resources and funding to it if we do this for the general population level.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For individuals, it is something that we will need to look at and assess, because the prevalence is different and the clinical effectiveness of the tests are different.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: To make a scheme out of this is something we need to assess because it will require some separate resourcing.
